name: Dropdown
description: A one-of choice that costs one button of space: the trigger shows the current item, the list opens on press. Use `Tabs` where the options fit and this where they do not, e.g. a language switcher in a phone header.

label.description: Trigger text; the selected label otherwise.

icon.description: Trigger icon, in place of text.

showValue.description: Trigger shows the selected value, not its label, so the list can read "Portugues" while the button reads "PT".
